$comment: Declared fault boundaries of the Project Administration `administration` executable. Expected failures (invalid requests, conflicts, unreadable events, lock contention) are typed results and never reach Aegis; Aegis captures only unexpected operational failure. Every boundary below is guarded by the single Aegis.capture scope in src/Administration.Cli/Program.fs.

boundaries.name: Installation event store
boundaries.$comment: installations/events/*.json and the generated projection on the local filesystem. Collisions, unreadable events and lock contention are StoreError results; anything else (disk full, permission denied) is captured.

boundaries.name: Installation request input
boundaries.$comment: echelon.installation.request/v1 documents from a file or stdin, and the optional Echelon Registry catalog. Malformed documents are typed invalid-request results; I/O failure while reading them is captured.

boundaries.name: Command output
boundaries.$comment: echelon.installation.result/v1 and query documents written to stdout.

persistence.$comment: Diagnostic events go to the console sink only; nothing is persisted.
